name: Todav: Tasks & Calendar
description:
Companion extension for Todav, a task list and calendar app for GNOME that keeps your tasks and events in your Nextcloud through CalDAV.

Shows a task list, the month with colored dots and the coming agenda in the top bar; clicking an item opens it in Todav.

Requires the Todav app (https://github.com/AperteDev/todav), whose Preferences hold the extension's options.
